thread:
anna: seeing a repeated p99 SLO miss on hosted/v1/text-gen over last 45m. Grafana -> https://grafana.internal/g/redwood/d/abcd... :frowning:

mike: looking... can you paste the query? I see CPU/GPU stable but batching pressure ramped

anna: PromQL: `sum(rate(batcher_max_batch_hits_total{model="redwood-v1"}[5m])) by (shard)`

raj: current max_batch=64 on that fleet, pack-window=8ms. p50 fine, p99 spikes when continuous batching pressure > 0.7

elaine: runtime logs show: "evicted 12 entries due to max_batch boundary" and "head_latency=220ms, tail=980ms"

sre-bot: alert: latency_slo_breach host=rg-34 service=batcher p99=1.02s

mike: quick mitigation: reduce max_batch to 32 for a canary pool and enable priority for small requests (<=64 tokens)

raj: agree. also suggest changing admission from request-count to token-count to avoid large-token requests starving batches

anna: cost question: reducing max_batch increases per-token GPU cost. how much? any rough numbers?

elaine: rough calc: with max_batch 64 we had throughput X, at 32 it's ~0.9X but p99 improves. translates to ~8-12% more GPU time on peak

mike: plan: 1) canary reduce max_batch->32 on 10% shards 2) enable small-req priority 3) monitor p95/p99 and token throughput 4) rollback if throughput drop >10% or errors >0.5%

raj: I'll push admission-controller patch. snippet:
```
admission:
  mode: token_based
  max_token_batch: 8000
  small_request_threshold_tokens: 64
  small_request_priority: high
```

anna: thx. schedule? we should avoid peak at 15:00 UTC

elaine: canary now on rg-canary-2, deploy-bot kicked it off

deploy-bot: deploy started for config=admission-token-canary by raj at 2026-03-17T14:12Z

mike: monitor dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/latency-batching and runbook: /runbooks/latency-batching

anna: results after 20m: p99 down from 1.02s -> 420ms on canary, throughput -6%

raj: rolling to 30% if stable another 30m

sre-bot: note: spike on other region eu-west-1 caused by smaller fleet capacity; consider region-specific max_batch

elaine: good call. adding region override to rollout

mike: :thumbsup:

anna: closing loop: add follow-up ticket to evaluate dynamic max_batch per model and token-size aware admission. assigned to raj+elaine

raj: created ticket RFC-7821

anna: thanks team :rocket:
